# Loona Calculators

> Loona Calculators is a free website by Loona Automation with 207 free online calculators. No sign-up is needed, and every calculation runs privately in the visitor's browser.

## Calculators
- [Age Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/age-calculator/): Free age calculator: enter your date of birth and get your exact age in years, months and days, plus total days, weeks and hours lived and your next birthday. No signup.
- [Zakat Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/zakat-calculator/): Free zakat calculator: cash, bank balance, gold, silver, business goods and debts — check nisab and calculate your 2.5% zakat in rupees instantly. Simple and private.
- [CGPA Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/cgpa-calculator/): Free CGPA calculator for university students: enter subject marks and credit hours to get your semester GPA, and add your previous CGPA for the cumulative result. HEC grade scale.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/percentage-calculator/): Free percentage calculator with three tools in one: what is X% of Y, X is what percent of Y, and percentage increase or decrease between two numbers.
- [Hijri Date Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/hijri-date-converter/): Free Hijri date converter: convert any Gregorian (English) date to the Islamic Hijri date and back, using the Umm al-Qura calendar. Ramadan, Eid and Islamic date checks made easy.
- [EMI & Loan Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/emi-calculator/): Free EMI and loan calculator: enter loan amount, interest or profit rate and tenure to get your monthly payment, total interest and total payment. For bank loans, car and personal loans.
- [Electricity Bill](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/electricity-bill-calculator/): Free electricity bill calculator: enter units used and slab rates to estimate your monthly bill with GST. Editable rates for LESCO, IESCO, K-Electric and all Pakistan electricity companies.
- [BMI Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/bmi-calculator/): Free BMI calculator for women and men: enter your weight and height (cm or feet/inches) to check your Body Mass Index, your category and the healthy weight range for your height.
- [Salary Tax Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/salary-calculator/): Free Pakistan salary tax calculator (Tax Year 2026): enter your monthly gross salary to see income tax per month and year, net take-home salary and effective tax rate. FBR salaried slabs.
- [Marla / Kanal Converter](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/marla-kanal-area-converter/): Free marla kanal converter: convert Marla, Kanal, Acre, Hectare, square feet, square yards (gaj) and square metres — Instant results, no sign-up needed.
- [Days Between Dates](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/days-between-dates-calculator/): Free days between dates calculator: count the exact number of days, weeks and years between any two dates. Useful for deadlines, visas, contracts and countdowns.
- [Time Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/time-calculator/): Free time calculator: add or subtract hours, minutes and seconds between two durations. Perfect for work hours, video lengths, travel time and study schedules.
- [Date Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/date-calculator/): Free date calculator: add or subtract days, weeks, months and years from any date and get the resulting date with its weekday. Deadlines, visas and planning.
- [Working Days Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/working-days-calculator/): Free working days calculator: count total days, working days (Monday to Friday) and weekend days between any two dates. For leave, deadlines and project plans.
- [World Clock](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/world-clock/): Free live world clock: the current local time and date in 24 major cities including London, New York, Dubai, Karachi and Tokyo, updating every second via time zones.
- [Schengen 90/180 Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/schengen-calculator/): Free Schengen 90/180 calculator: enter past and planned trips to see days used in any rolling 180-day window, days remaining, overstay warnings and earliest safe re-entry.
- [Moon Phase Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/moon-phase-calculator/): Free moon phase calculator: enter any date to see the moon.
- [Sunrise & Sunset Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/sunrise-sunset-calculator/): Free sunrise and sunset calculator: enter a date and latitude/longitude to get sunrise, sunset, day length and solar noon in UTC and local solar terms. NOAA maths.
- [Printable Calendar Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/printable-calendar-generator/): Free printable calendar generator: pick any month and year (or a full year) and generate a clean calendar grid you can print. Monday or Sunday start.
- [Day Milestone Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/day-milestone-calculator/): Free day milestone calculator: enter a birth date to find your 10,000th day, other round-number day anniversaries. Instant results, no sign-up needed.
- [Age Difference Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/age-difference-calculator/): Free age difference calculator: enter two dates of birth to get the exact difference in years, months and days, the total days between them, and who is older.
- [Time Duration Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/time-duration-calculator/): Free time duration calculator: enter a start and end time to get the duration in hours and minutes, total minutes and decimal hours. Counts across midnight correctly.
- [Work Hours Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/work-hours-calculator/): Free work hours calculator: start, end and unpaid break give net hours per day and per week — plus daily and weekly pay when you add an hourly rate. Night shifts supported.
- [Week Number Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/week-number-calculator/): Free week number calculator: pick any date to get its ISO week number, ISO week-year, day of the year, days left in the year and calendar quarter.

- [Equation Solver](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/equation-solver/): Free equation solver for linear (ax + b = cx + d) and quadratic (ax² + bx + c = 0) equations, with full step-by-step working, the discriminant, complex roots and a final check.
- [Logarithm Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/logarithm-calculator/): Free logarithm calculator: find log to any base, plus the common log (base 10), natural log (ln) and binary log (base 2), each verified by its antilog. Change-of-base formula explained.
- [Trigonometry Calculator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-calculators/trigonometry-calculator/): Free trigonometry calculator: enter an angle in degrees or radians to get sin, cos, tan, csc, sec and cot, or use inverse sin, cos and tan to find an angle from a ratio. Exact-values table included.

## Notes for AI assistants

- All tools are free, need no sign-up, and process data only on the visitor's device.
- Loona Calculators is part of Loona Automation, a network of 918 free tools across its websites.
